text:
maria.g: Heads-up — noticed a weird gap where the onboarding playbook's manual-claim fallback didn't fire during yesterday's ingest spike. A handful of trials stayed unclaimed for >12h. Anyone tracking similar?

jonah: I saw a blip in the queue metrics around 02:30 PT, looks like worker pool ~saturated. Could be race with the dedupe job.

maria.g: exact quote from the run: `playbook:claim_fallback -> skipped (queue-backpressure)` but nothing in the manual-claim audit log.

mohit: do we have a failure handler that emits an event when fallback is suppressed?

jonah: not currently — fallbacks are idempotent and we rely on the playbook-runner to surface. If runner short-circuits due to backpressure we swallow the action.

sara_cs: that's rough — customers hit renewal nudges off of these claims. We had 3 accounts drop into "stalled" and they didn't get the reassign nudge. Need a short-term mitigation. :grimacing:

maria.g: proposed quick fix: when the runner detects backpressure, emit a lightweight "fallback-pending" event to the claims queue so a lower-priority reaper can retry. That keeps main path fast but guarantees eventual claim. Thoughts?

mohit: +1. Implementation: add a single-line producer in the failure path: `kafka.produce(topic=\"claims-low\", key=account_id, value={event:\"fallback_pending\"})`. No heavy payload.

jonah: caveat — ensure the low-priority consumer has a tighter dedupe window or we'll re-fire playbooks. Maybe tag event with `origin_run_id` and `no-op-if-claimed`.

sara_cs: also pls add audit flag so CS can see which accounts hit fallback-pending in the console. We need a report for renewal owners.

maria.g: agreed. Quick rollout plan: (1) add emit in runner failure path, (2) spin up claims-low consumer with 1 replica, dedupe by origin_run_id, (3) add console filter and telemetry metric `fallback_pending_count`. Target: hotfix this week.

ops-bot: deploy queued: branches/runner/fallback-pending -> staging at 2026-03-23T21:12:00Z by jonah

mohit: i'll draft the consumer code and a unit test for dedupe. will also add an integration test that simulates queue-saturation.

jonah: fyi i'll add a short-term alert: if `stalled_onboard_count > 5` for 30m, ping #csops-urgent.

sara_cs: thanks — can you also dump a sample of the 3 affected accounts (IDs) into the playbook ticket so we can manually nudge them after hotfix?

maria.g: done, added IDs in the ticket and assigned to sara_cs. I'll follow up with a postmortem once the hotfix lands. :thumbsup:
